description: Details of one ETF/ETC/ETN by ticker or ISIN (e.g. "ETFBTBSP", "PLBTBSP00012", "IEAC"): index, ongoing cost, distribution, replication, base currency, currency hedging, first listing date, fund assets, legal form, domicile, launch date, KID; for bond ETFs also duration, number of bonds, fund assets, average rating, high yield share, tracking difference by year and portfolio breakdown by sector, country and rating. Each value has its source, date and quality (confirmed, to_verify with a note, missing with a reason). Szczegóły jednego ETF.
